next_step: Deliver Dedicated sizing doc + formal POC proposal; schedule procurement kickoff
notes: Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) — ran 3-week Hosted API trial, now moving to evaluation of Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Hosted trial observations (quantitative): avg QPS 18 during business hours, 120 concurrent sessions at peak, avg prompt+completion 420 tokens (prompt 80 / completion 340), 60% of calls were short-chat (<=150 tokens).
Cost sensitivity: strong — CFO asked for 6-9 month payback on Dedicated commit vs Hosted variable. Team wants model/quantization recommendations to meet latency/cost targets.
Latency needs: median p95 generation <= 600ms for chat flows, background batch embeddings can accept higher latency. Must maintain <1s p95 for in-product assistant under expected load.
Security: must run in customer VPC for data residency, KMS integration required. SOC2 proof provided; they require answers to additional audit items (see linked drive doc).
POC ask: 1-week Dedicated POC sizing for 200 QPS burst capacity, 50 sustained QPS, autoscale to handle 400 concurrent KV-cache sessions. Demo to include canary fallback to hosted model variant.
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family 70B quantized variant for cost; willing to consider 1.3B for high-concurrency routes. Request routing by cost/latency per route.
Routing/fallback: must support region-aware routing (NA primary, EU fallback) and automatic fallback to lower-cost quantized variant if Dedicated capacity saturated.
POC metrics to capture: tokens per route, cache hit rate, latency distribution by model variant, cost per 1M tokens, tail latency during prefix-cache warmup.
Sales touchpoints: demo 2025-02-12 (hosted features + console), pricing review 2025-02-26, security deep-dive 2025-03-03. AE/SE present: Maya (AE), Daniel (SE).
Customer quotes / paraphrases: 'We liked the prefix caching behavior — reduced perceived latency for agents.'; 'Need a clear committed price that beats Hosted at scale.'
Docs shared: dedicated sizing template, example GPU config sheet, draft POC SOW (drive links above).
Risk notes: procurement timeline uncertain (quarterly budget cycle); legal flagged a data residency clause that may push to Private instead of VPC-hosted Dedicated.

Action items assigned: Daniel to produce capacity recommendation (GPU type, shard plan) by 2025-03-07; Maya to circulate draft pricing options for 1yr/3yr commits; security to return completed questionnaire by 2025-03-10.

Proposed Dedicated starting config (draft): 4x A10G-equivalent GPUs with model shard + 2x warm standby for autoscale, estimated baseline throughput 50 QPS for 70B quantized with batching; add burst lane for high-concurrency chat at cost tier X.
Preliminary financial modeling: customer estimated savings vs Hosted ~35% at 100k monthly tokens, ~55% at 1M monthly tokens if commit accepted. Exact math pending final token-mix inputs.
Suggested next meeting: POC kickoff + procurement introduction (30-45m) — target week of 2025-03-10.
CRM shorthand: 'eval -> dedicated sizing. SE to calc qps/concurrency + token mix. Legal DPA in progress.'
capacity_sizing_summary: Observed peak: 18 QPS avg, 120 concurrent sessions. Recommendation draft: 4 GPU nodes (A10G equiv) + 2 standby, target sustained 50 QPS, burst to 200 QPS for 2 min windows; batching config: dynamic batch up to 32 tokens, prefix cache expected to reduce compute by ~20%.
token_mix_profile: 60% chat (short turns, 150 tokens avg), 25% long-form generation (avg 900 tokens), 15% embeddings jobs (batch offline). P95 token size dominated by long-form nightly reports.
pricing_conversation_notes: Customer asked for 1yr and 3yr committed options. Pricing sensitivity at entry: require ~30-40% discount vs Hosted list. Discussed add-ons: longer observability retention and enterprise support at extra cost.
